title: Inflexion takes minority stake in French green nail polish brand Manucurist
summary: The French nail polish and nail care brand has signed an agreement with Inflexion, a European private equity firm specializing in mid-market companies, which will acquire a minority stake in the business. Inflexion's investment will support Manucurist's founders and management team in accelerating international growth, particularly in the United States, expanding its physical retail footprint and further developing online sales.
